**Summary**  
Patient C3L-01313 has a high GNN-A out-of-fold risk estimate (0.89) for stage III–IV ccRCC. The model attributes ~82 % of the risk signal to tumor-protein drivers (PSMB6, PLCL1, GULP1, TNS2, LMO7, RAB25, USP4, CORO2B) and ~18 % to recorded comorbidities (hyperlipidemia, coronary artery atherosclerosis) [pred:C3L-01313:gnn]. The tumor carries somatic mutations in VHL (p.E94*), BAP1 (p.W52G), MEN1 (p.A526T) and MLLT1 (p.E358D) [pt:C3L-01313:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3L-01313:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:8314][pt:C3L-01313:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:4221][pt:C3L-01313:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:4298]. Model-ranked drugs that score unusually high for this patient’s tumor proteome include Artenimol, Minodronic acid, Aspartic acid, Fumaric acid and Artesunate [rank:C3L-01313:drug:DRUGBANK:DB11638][rank:C3L-01313:drug:DRUGBANK:DB06548][rank:C3L-01313:drug:DRUGBANK:DB00128][rank:C3L-01313:drug:DRUGBANK:DB01677][rank:C3L-01313:drug:DRUGBANK:DB09274].

**Evidence paths**  
- VHL loss (p.E94*) → ER/mitochondrial localization of VHL protein [E3587363][E3601956] → dysregulated hypoxia response (EGLN1/PHD2 2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase activity) [E3551338][E3703431].  
- BAP1 mutation → chromatin/DNA repair disruption (BAP1 is a deubiquitinase; not directly linked in subgraph).
